newsitem.title: USA: NEBRASKA FED CATTLE $105/DRESSED, STEADY - USDA.
newsitem.headline: NEBRASKA FED CATTLE $105/DRESSED, STEADY - USDA.

text.p: Slaughter steers and heifers were fully steady, USDA said. Demand and seller interest good.

Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1225-1325 lbs - mostly 105.00, instances 105.50, pen predominately Choice 106.00, few early 104.00.(weighted average 105.07). Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1075-1225 lbs -105.00. Confirmed - 19,700 Last Week - 15,400 Last Year - 1,400 Wk To Date - 24,000 Sm Pd Lst Wk- 20,300 Sm Pd Lst Yr- 5,100
Live basis sales - Equivalent 3 percent shrink delivered and FOB, some FOB 4% shrink. Dressed basis delivered (paid on hot carcass weights)
